name: Hungary

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and green.
flag.symbolism: Red is commonly said to stand for strength, white for faithfulness and green for hope.

hook: Hungary is Italy's colors laid flat with red on top; Bulgaria starts with white, and Iran and Tajikistan add emblems.
trivia: During the 1956 uprising, protesters cut the communist emblem out of the flag, leaving a hole that became a symbol of the revolution.
The red-white-green tricolor became a national symbol during the 1848 revolution.
